answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The echo of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The cipher lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the marble is where a second reviewer recomputes them. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, released only after three unrelated confirmations. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short.
